company.name: Able Health
company.shortDescription: Able Health provides cloud-based pay-for-performance and risk adjustment solutions for care managers and physicians.
company.description:
Able Health is a cloud platform that automates the tracking and reporting processes of value-based programs to help physicians more on treatment rather than paperwork. 

The platform consolidates all pattern data that have been pulled from all health records and claims in order to calculate how much money is earned; tracks performance by contract with different insurance companies; simplifies reporting going out to insurance companies; provides compressed information to clinicians; and delivers feedback to physicians and clinic managers on how to improve performance. 

Able Health was launched by Steve Daniels and Rachel Katz in April 2015 and is based in San Francisco, California.
